test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 21 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b33444b1d8e68b5dfb502ef8337969db5a2c813d191b2c09dc1141ee6e0d8c0.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2, and figure 3 to 4:

Top-left and bottom-left symbols are interchanging their position.

Top-right, middle, and bottom-right symbols are shifting their position in an anticlockwise direction.

From figure 2 to 3, and figure 4 to 5:

All 4 corner symbols are shifting their position in clockwise direction.

Middle symbols are replaced by a new symbol.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5459bea566edbc0c32e97304679687f5a5c6a614c38317d2d59a4a1044019ad0.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
